name: ZSP_ODM_DATA_EXPLORE
description: This table stores the statistics of an attribute code. For example, percentage of NULL or distinct value, Mean,Mode, Median etc.

columns.name: DATA_EXP_ID
columns.description: DATA_EXP_ID, primary key of table.

columns.name: DATA_EXP_JOB_ID
columns.description: DATA_EXP_JOB_ID is from ZSP_ODM_DATA_EXP_JOBS table.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_CODE
columns.description: Attribute code of an entity.

columns.name: DATA_TYPE
columns.description: Data Type of an attribute code.

columns.name: NULL_PERCENT
columns.description: Percentage of NULL values of an attribute.

columns.name: DISTINCT_CNT
columns.description: Count of Distinct values of an attribute.

columns.name: DISTINCT_PERCENT
columns.description: Percentage of Distinct values of an attribute.

columns.name: MODE_VALUE
columns.description: Mode value of an attribute.

columns.name: AVG_VALUE
columns.description: Average value of an attribute.

columns.name: AVG_DATE
columns.description: Average Date value of an attribute.

columns.name: AVG_TS_TZ
columns.description: Average Timestamp with timezone value of an attribute.

columns.name: MEDIAN_VALUE
columns.description: Median value of an attribute.

columns.name: MEDIAN_DATE
columns.description: Median Date value of an attribute.

columns.name: MEDIAN_TS_TZ
columns.description: Median timestamp with timezone value of an attribute.

columns.name: MIN_VALUE
columns.description: Minimum value of an attribute.

columns.name: MAX_VALUE
columns.description: Maximum value of an attribute.

columns.name: STD_VALUE
columns.description: Standard Deviation value of an attribute.

columns.name: VARIANCE_VALUE
columns.description: Variance value of an attribute.

columns.name: SKEWNESS
columns.description: Skewness.

columns.name: KURTOSIS
columns.description: Kurtosis.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
